questions.prompt: Name a letter of the Arabic alphabet.

answers.explanation: م — as in Alif Lam Mim.
ن — a surah opens with it.
ت and ث (and the emphatic ط).
ق and ك — two different letters (a surah is named after Qaf).
ص — a surah is named after it.
ع — a sound special to Arabic.
ض — Arabic is called "the language of dad".
